legend: For each pair of integers $X$ and $Y$, print the sum of all odd numbers strictly between them ($X$ and $Y$ themselves are not included).
input: The first line contains $T$ ($1 \le T \le 10$), the number of test cases. Each of the next $T$ lines contains two integers $X$ and $Y$ ($0 \le X, Y \le 10^4$).
output: For each test case print the sum on its own line.
